concepts.def: ~1750-1820; clarity, balance, sonata form; orchestra expanded.
1770-1827; bridged Classical and Romantic; 9 symphonies including the 5th and 9th ('Choral').
1732-1809; 'father of the symphony and string quartet'; 104 symphonies.
Three-part structure: exposition, development, recapitulation; basis of first movements.
Multi-movement orchestral work, typically four movements.
